should be called for counseling.

positions have been filled up?

this aspect.

Counsel for the State of Uttarakhand.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner has 
relied upon the Rules dealing with “Waiting

instructions as to whether the said Rules are 
applicable to the selection in question or not.

negative, then the reason for non-application
